title: Cocoa and Blueberry Brownies
excerpt: Enjoy fudgy pure cocoa brownies combined with the juiciness of our fresh blueberries. An irresistible dessert that is easy to make and perfect for sharing.
imageAlt: Fudgy cocoa brownies cut into squares with fresh blueberries baked inside and on top.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup ground panela (unrefined cane sugar) or honey

steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and grease a square baking pan of about 20x20 cm (8x8 in).
In a large bowl, beat the eggs with the ground panela, the melted coconut oil and the vanilla until well combined.
Sift in the cocoa powder, oat flour, baking powder and salt. Mix gently with a spatula until you get a thick batter.
Carefully fold in the Fresh Pick blueberries, grown in the mountains of Guasca, so they spread evenly without breaking.
Pour the batter into the pan and spread it carefully with the spatula.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until the edges are firm and a toothpick inserted near the center comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Let the pan cool on a rack for 10 minutes before cutting into squares and serving.
tips: Toss the blueberries in a teaspoon of oat flour before adding them to the batter; this keeps them from sinking to the bottom while baking.
Store the brownies in an airtight container in the fridge so their texture becomes even fudgier and the sweet contrast between the cocoa and the blueberries stands out.
